<missing 21> is the expression for the coefficients of the polynomial $P(x)$. We can find this in <expression 2>:
<expression 2> $P(a_{n})=a_{n}^{k}+C_{k-1}a_{n}^{k-1}+...+C_{1}a_{n}+k!m^{k}$

<missing 22> is the expression for the infinite sequence of positive integers $a_n$. We can find this in <expression 14>:
<expression 14> $a_{n+j}=a_{n}+g(j)=a_{1}+f(n+j)$

<missing 23> is the condition that $m$ should be a non-negative integer. This is covered in <expression 23>:
<expression 23> $\forall m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}$

<missing 24> is the final expression for the infinite sequence $a_n$. Combining the information from <expression 14> and <expression 19>, we get:
